title: Own PIN and limits per role
problem: Everyone shared one PIN and one discount limit, so approvals could not be traced to a person.
now: Each role has its limits (discount, price, refund, void, drawer, due); over them an approver enters their own PIN, which can be changed. Return & exchange and the phone register follow the same limits.
steps: Open a shift as Rafi and give 10% off

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
